item.title: Ask HN: What are your favorite free daily web-based games?
item.summary: I have a short list of web-based games I play daily (mostly word games), and I'm looking to add a few more that scratch that particular itch for me. Does anyone have any recommendations? Eligible games should be a) free to play; b) web-based rather than an app; and c) a new puzzle every day. Here are mine currently: Tiled Words: https://tiledwords.com/puzzles/daily 4x3: https://www.hankgreen.com/fourbythree/ Ribbit: https://www.puzzmo.com/puzzle/today/ribbit Uncrossy: https://uncrossy.com/ (Wordle used to be on the list, but I grew tired of it, coinciding with the recent puzzle solution 'PSHAW') Disclaimer: I have built such a game myself, and I do play it daily for testing purposes, but I'm omitting it here to avoid appearance of shameless self-promotion.
